composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-116, "E.R. FAN / FUEL VALVES / TANK IND.") serves several distinct systems that happen to share the DC MAIN PANEL supply and a mid-column wire-tag terminal block: (1) Engine-room ventilation (blower/extractor/E-stop signals routed to a VENTILATION CONTROL BOX via T/S C), which is the 599-ventilation-fans / 599-engroom-blower-extractor domain; (2) Fuel transfer equipment — manual fuel pump, transfer valve, auto (ONYX) fuel pump, port/stbd tank valves, day-tank valve — matching 550-fuel-transfer by the engineer-confirmed mapping; (3) Fuel/water tank level senders (port/stbd outboard, inboard, day tank, port/stbd water) feeding XA50 connector, which is tank monitoring — no dedicated fuel/water-tank-sender node exists in the register, closest is 652-onyx-monitoring (ONYX Monitoring & Control) since ONYX is named directly on this sheet (AUTO FUEL PUMP = ONYX per mapping) and XA50/XA21 are its connector blocks; (4) Emergency engine stop wiring (Q17, Re25, terminals 136-140) matching 654-emergency-stops; (5) MYT HYDRAULICS breaker Q18 feeding MYT MAST/ENG.ROOM/AFT PLC taps (141-144), matching 570-myt-systems-hydraulics and its PLC racks (570-plc-rack-mast/er/aft); (6) Fire gate/gas release/door-switch/fire-siren circuit (terminals 131,132,157-159) matching 695-fire-system (gas release) per mapping ENG.ROOM GAS RELEASE ALARM; (7) RACOR fuel filter monitoring (+RACOR block, senders 1-3 via XA40) matching 550-racor-fuel-filters. The DC MAIN PANEL / T/S B / T/S C / T/S E / numbered wire-tag terminal column and Re20-Re26 relay bank are shared infrastructure of the panel, not equipment in themselves — attached to 640-dc-distribution as the owning distribution node.
